task_completion.description: The agent queries the SeisComP database or uses SeisComP tools to find an earthquake with Magnitude > 7.0.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing a MySQL query (mysql -u sysop -psysop) or SeisComP command-line tool output displaying earthquake parameters.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies the correct earthquake data (Event ID, UTC Time, Mag, Lat, Lon) from the query results.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent's terminal or text editor shows the extracted values for the Noto Peninsula earthquake (Magnitude > 7.0).

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the Japan Standard Time (JST) by adding 9 hours to the UTC Origin Time.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A command, script, or manual calculation visible in the trajectory showing the addition of 9 hours to the UTC timestamp.

task_completion.description: The agent creates an HTML file at the specified path /home/ga/Documents/noto_report.html.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like VS Code or nano) or a 'cat' command showing the HTML structure being saved to the correct file path.

task_completion.description: The report includes all required fields: Event ID, UTC Time, JST Time, Magnitude, Lat, Lon, and the Google Maps link.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot of the final HTML file content or the file opened in a browser showing all 7 required data points and the correctly formatted Google Maps URL.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply write the report from memory but actually queried the database.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory must show a database query or SeisComP tool execution before the HTML file is created.

integrity.description: The agent saved the file to the exact path requested, not a temporary directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The save command or file explorer shows the path /home/ga/Documents/noto_report.html.

integrity.description: The agent performed the +9 hour conversion rather than guessing the time.
integrity.visual_evidence: Evidence of the agent noting the UTC time and explicitly adding 9 hours to reach the JST value.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target earthquake is the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake with a Magnitude > 7.0. The JST time must be exactly UTC + 9 hours. The output must be a file at /home/ga/Documents/noto_report.html. The Google Maps link must follow the format: https://maps.google.com/?q=<lat>,<lon>.
